% The URL of another document's PDF with xr loaded after hyperref. The page
% builds, and each reference prints as without a URL: a label of an .aux
% that LaTeX wrote as in the PDF, with no link, and one of an .aux that
% tex4ht wrote under hyperref, with its .xref, as a link to that
% document's page.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{xr}
\externaldocument[X-]{test-xr/latex}[https://example.org/ext.pdf]
\externaldocument[H-]{test-xrurl/xr-hyperref}[https://example.org/hyper.pdf]
\begin{document}
CaseL \ref{X-ss}, page \pageref{X-front}, named \nameref{X-thm},
auto \autoref{X-thm}.

CaseM \ref{H-oss}.

\section{Here}\label{here}
Local \ref{here}.
\end{document}
